walkieTypie.noLocalData: LOCAL DATA NOT FOUND OR EMPTY.

hints.push: PUSH — Step forward to a newer record. Records are stacked newest-on-top. If you're already at the newest, PUSH opens a blank page — type anything and it becomes a new record.
hints.pull: PULL — Step back to an older record. If you're on a blank page and typed text, PULL saves it first, then moves back.
hints.commit: COMMIT — Upload ALL records of the selected branch to the cloud. Replaces the entire cloud copy with your local version — if another device uploaded first, yours overwrites it. Attached files are uploaded too.
hints.checkout: CHECKOUT — Re-download this branch from the cloud. Overwrites your local copy with the latest cloud version.
hints.switch: SWITCH — Jump to a different branch. If it only exists on the cloud, it will be downloaded to your device first.
hints.fork: FORK — Copy every record from the selected branch into a brand-new branch. The original and the copy are fully independent — edits to one never affect the other.
hints.dropClean: CLEAN — Erase all records in this branch but keep the branch itself. One blank placeholder remains so the branch stays in your list.
hints.dropDrop: DROP — Delete the cloud backup of this branch. Your local records on this device remain untouched.
hints.dropDelete: DELETE — Permanently remove this empty branch from your device. Cannot be undone.
hints.themeToggle: Toggle between the default dark CRT theme and the light theme. Only available when a Light Theme MOD is installed.
hints.shelfHandle: Panel handle. Double-click to close. Drag left/right to resize the panel width.

wt.theyPush: View a newer record on your partner's board. Their board is read-only — you can browse but not edit.
wt.theyPull: View an older record on your partner's board.
wt.wePush: Step forward to a newer record on your board (your partner sees this board in real-time). At the newest, opens a blank page for a new record.
wt.wePull: Step back to an older record on your board. Saves your current text before moving.
wt.add: ADD — Connect with another user by entering their UID. Both of you get a paired board: you write on yours, they write on theirs, and each side sees the other's board in real-time.
wt.cut: CUT — Disconnect the selected partner. Removes the link and erases all records for this pair on both sides.

bc.pin: PIN — Bookmark this channel. Pinned channels always appear at the top of your list for quick access.
bc.cast: CAST — Publish ALL your local records to this channel. Replaces the channel's entire cloud content with your local version (full upload, not just the current record).
bc.create: CREATE — Start a new local channel. Write records locally, then CAST to make them public. Requires a title (set via /title command).
bc.delete: DELETE — Permanently destroy this channel and all its records, both local and cloud. Only the channel owner can do this. Cannot be undone.

mods.refresh: Re-scan all MOD templates and refresh their connection status.

config.maxSlot: Maximum records kept per branch. When full, the oldest record is auto-pruned on PUSH or PULL.
config.autoCleanBlanks: Auto-delete empty (blank) records whenever you PUSH or PULL. Keeps your history clean.
config.updateTimestamp: When editing an older record, move it to the newest position (HEAD). OFF = edit stays in its original position.
config.autoSync: Auto-fetch from the cloud when another device pushes changes. Requires login.
config.loopList: Wrap around: scrolling past the last item jumps to the first, and vice versa.
config.boardSwap: Swap board order: show the remote (partner's) board on top by default.
config.screensaverTimeout: Seconds of inactivity before the screensaver activates. Set to max (310) to effectively disable.
config.crtBlendMode: Apply overlay blend mode to CRT scanlines. Softens the retro glow effect.

llm.button: Send the current text to AI with your configured prompt. Output appears in the panel below.
llm.provider: Where AI runs — client: in your browser via WebGPU (offline, private). server: local Ollama instance. apikey: cloud API (needs internet + API key).
llm.clientModel: AI model downloaded and run inside your browser via WebGPU. Larger models are smarter but need more GPU memory (VRAM).
llm.apiProvider: Which cloud AI service to use (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.).
llm.apiModel: The specific model ID from your cloud provider (e.g. gpt-4o-mini, claude-sonnet-4-5-20250514).
llm.apiKey: Your secret API key for the cloud provider. Stored in browser localStorage only — never sent to our server.
llm.temperature: Controls AI randomness. 0 = precise and deterministic. 1 = creative and varied. 0.3–0.7 is a good middle ground.

llmBb.button: Feed blackboard records to AI for analysis (summarize, extract, transform, etc.).
llmBb.target: What to analyze: records from the current branch (LOG view), the BRANCH list view, or all branches combined.

llmBc.button: Feed broadcast channel content to AI for analysis.
llmBc.target: What to analyze: the current record only, or the channel's entire history.

translate.button: Translate the current text into your configured target language. Result appears in the panel below.

stt.button: Start recording from your microphone. When you stop, speech is converted to text and inserted into the editor.

markdownPreview.button: Render the current text as formatted Markdown in the panel below (headings, bold, lists, code blocks, etc.).

aa.matrixRain: Falling green characters on the screensaver, Matrix-style. Pure visual decoration — no performance impact when idle.
aa.perlinBg: Animated flowing noise texture behind page content. Subtle background atmosphere effect.
aa.mouseLight: A soft glow that follows your cursor, like a flashlight sweeping across the CRT screen.
aa.toastAnim: Braille-pattern spinner animation on loading notifications. Adds a visual indicator while operations are in progress.

mods.configDefault: Select a MOD from the list.
mods.catalogPreview: Add this MOD to start configuring.
